BLOOD DONATION CAMP 
Name of Activity : Blood Donation Campaigning and collecting the blood.  
Need of the Activity : To overcome the deaths caused by scarcity of blood.  
NSS Unit of S.V. College of Engineering  has organized “Blood Donation Camp”  in 
collaboration with Sri Venkateswara Ramnarain Ruia G overnment General Hospital (Ruia Hospital) and 
WE ARE WITH YOU (Charitable Trust), Tirupati on 08-06-2022. The camp was started by Principal Dr. 
N. Sudhakar Reddy by lightening the lamp and delivered a speech on advantages of blood donation. The 
Students, Teaching and Non teaching staff  were actively participated in the Blood Donation Camp. The 
objective of thi s camp is to create awareness in Students & Staff Members about importance of their 
donation in every human being life. As per the schedule all the student and faculty donors gathered to 
donate blood and the camp was started with Haemoglobin and other prel iminary examinations. After the 
screening doctors declared that most of the students are eligible to donate blood and 110 + units were 
collected. Fruit juice was  provided to all the donors along with the certificates and RUIA  team 
congratulated the students who donated blood for the needy. 
Snapshot of Photos is displayed below along with press clipping.

WORLD BLOOD DONORS DAY 
Name of Activity : World  Blood Donors Day.  
Need of the Activity : To overcome the deat hs caused by scarcity of blood and Appreciation of 
the institutions for their support.  
NSS Unit of S.V.  COLLEGE OF ENGINEERING has participated in World Blood Donor Day Program 
Conducted by Sri Venkateswara Institute of Medical Sciences, Department of Blood Transfusion medicine, 
Tirupati on 14 -06-2022 on the behalf of Institution, NSS Programme officer  has attended for the program and 
received a certificate of Appreciation from Dr B Vengamma, Director of SVIMS , Tirupati. The Convener of the 
program and SVIMS Blood Bank in charge Dr. S Sreedhar Babu have addressed the gathering about benefits of 
blood donation and the diseases transmitted through blood etc.The theme of this year is-“Donating blood is an act 
of solidarity, Join the effort and save the lives”  Several participants were expressed their views and opinions in 
this regard.

INDEPENDENCE WEEK CELEBRATIONS 
 
Name of Activity : Independence Week Celebrations 
 
Need of the Activity:  To enhance the worship and respect to the freedom fighters and nation. 
 
S V College of Engineering, NSS Unit has conducted the Independence week celebrations from 
8th to 15 th august, 2022  followed by Azadi Ka Amrit M ahostav-Har Ghar Tiranga at college 
campus and adopted village Venkatapuram. On this occasion rally was conducted with  200 meters 
national flag thereafter drawing & elocution competitions were conducted at college and adopted 
village. A pledge was taken from all the students and faculty and distributed flags to households  at 
Venkatapuram in the presence of Sarpanch Mrs. M Suseela & Village Revenue  Officer Mr. T 
Purushotham. Best performers were awarded with prizes on 15th august @ 76 th Independence day 
celebrations. A skit on Unity in diversity was also performed by volunteers to mark the occasion.  
 
Few photographs of the programme are attached herewith for kind perusal.

NATIONAL UNITY DAY 
Name of Activity : Elocution competition and Pledge taking ceremony  
Need of the Activity : To permeate the message of unity. 
India is a secular country with diversified cultures and significances in its own kind. As an 
Endeavour to solidify the bond of oneness and unification, NSS Unit of Sri Venkateswara College of 
Engineering celebrated the birth anniversary of Sardar Vall abhbhai Patel on 31 October 2022  as 
Rashtriya Ekta Diwas  (National Unity Day ). In line with the celebrations countrywide,  NSS 
Unit organized various activities at adopted village Venkatapuram to extend heartfelt appreciation about 
the life of the great leader, Sardar Patel. The idea was to infuse in the young future generation, the values 
integrated with the knowledge and adoration about the country’s rich heritage. A throng of activities was 
organized to support the cause of promoting unity and celebrating “National Unity Day”. 
A celebration started with a pledge taking ceremony followed by elocution competition on the 
theme of Unity is S trength. The occasion reaffirmed the importance of unity, integrity and security 
amongst the students and the inherent streng th and resilience of our nation to withstand any actual and 
potential threats which may affect us on the whole.  In the end, we took an oath to preserve the unity, 
integrity and security of the nation in the spirit of unification of the county.

SAMVIDHAN DIVAS 
Name of Activity : Pledge ceremony  and elocution competition on pros and cons of 
constitution. 
Need of the Activity : To recall the fundamental duties and rights of Indian constitution along         
                                                with preamble. 
S V College of Engineering has observed the 7 3rd Constitution Day also named as Samvidhan 
Divas on 26 th November, 2022. This event was organized by the National Service Scheme unit of the 
college. This event will not only carry the message of “Fundamental rights and Duties” but also permeate 
the youth with values assimilated by the knowledge and respect about the country’s diverse legacy. There 
was an active participation of students and staff members in the pledge ceremony  and elocution 
competition.  
Preamble of the Indian Constitution: 
 The throng of activities started with reading the preamble by Dr. N Sudhakar  Reddy, Principal that 
embarked the essence of Indian Constitution among the fellow students. The following preamble had 
been taken by the students: 
 “We, the people of India , having solemnly resolved to constitute India into a sovereign socialist secular 
democratic republic and to secure to all its citizens:  
JUSTICE, social, economic and political;  
LIBERTY of thought, expression, belief, faith and worship;  
EQUALITY of status and of opportunity; and to promote among them all  
FRATERNITY assuring the dignity of the individual and the unity and integrity of the Nation;

ourselves this constitution.”

74 th Republic Day Celebrations 
Name of Activity :  74th Republic day 
Need of the Activity : To remind the sacrifice of our patriotic heroes. 
     India marks January 26 as its Republic Day every year . In 2023 , the country is 
celebrating its 74 th Republic Day. While India gained independence from the British Raj in 1947, it 
wasn’t until January 26, 1950, that the Indian Constitution came into effect, and India became a 
sovereign state, declaring it a republic. Dr . BR Ambedkar headed the Drafting Committee of the 
Constitution. Additionally, Constitution Day is celebrated in India on November 26 every year, as on 
November 26, 1949, the Constituent Assembly of India adopted the Constitution of India. 
The day was celebrated in our college with great eclat. The college premises was 
tastefully decorated with flowerpots and national flags. We were beside ourselves with joy. 
Loudspeakers were fitted. Everyone was feeling very patriotic and happy because it was a matter of 
great pride for all of us. After all, on this day the constitution of India came into force and our 
country became a republic. 
On this day, the principal Dr. N Sudhakar Reddy hoists the flag on the institution ground. 
The main attraction of  Republic Day celebrations is singing a patriotic song, speech on freedom 
fighters, and dance on republic day theme by students at the S V College of Engineering followed by 
prize distribution. This event begins with flag hosting by Principal Dr. N Sudhakar Reddy then he 
speaks a few words about freedom fighters and fundamental rights. These were followed by stirring

NATIONAL SCIENCE DAY 
Name of Activity :  National Science Day 
Need of the Activity : To inspire the students towards research and innovations. 
The National Science Day  is celebrated by Department of Science & Humanities in 
association with National Service Scheme at S V College of Engineering on 28 th  February to mark 
the discovery of the Raman Effect  by Indian physicist Sir Chandrashekhara Venkata Raman . 
The program started with the welcome speech by  Principal Dr N Sudhakar Reddy and HOD           
Dr N Manohar Reddy on the theme of Global science for a global wellbeing . Various events like 
Essay writing, elocution and quiz were conducted and awarded prizes. 100 students were benefitted. 
On the following objectives, S V College of Engineering  has organized the National 
Science Day activities for the year 2023. 
1. To promote active involvement of students and teachers in science related activity.  
2. Encourage students to ask questions and to get doubts cleared in different areas of   
science and promote their effective participation.   
3. Enable students to know about the latest developments in the fields of science and 
technology.
